name: @margoengine/webgl2-compat
description: WebGL2 compatibility for browsers without WebGPU: install() runs the real renderer with a WebGPU-shaped device, WGSL translation and tiered compute. Optional /preview, /pick, /restore and /auto entries preserve the smaller preview on lower-tier WebGL2; /xr supports WebXR.
author: Scott Campbell

scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node test/browser-check.mjs && node test/glsl-corpus-browser.mjs && cd ../.. && node packages/webgl2-compat/test/corpus-draw-browser.mjs

scripts.test:gpu:tiers: npm run build && cd ../.. && node packages/webgl2-compat/test/tiers-browser.mjs && node packages/webgl2-compat/test/tier-packages-browser.mjs
